policy.applicableRequirement: UI, interaction, navigation and refresh that can be verified by a local production build are accepted through CI plus real local production-build screenshots; the deployed merge commit must be READY and served. Generic production sign-in is no longer required for this class.
policy.externalServiceAcceptanceStillRequiredFo: Real subscriptions, OAuth, model providers, GitHub App, payments, push and other external services

A.basis: 19 dynamically confirmed defects have trigger/root cause/minimal patch/red-to-green evidence and source-bound baseline records

B.basis: Real local production cold Settings, history navigation, stable navigation/content loading and no extra ordinary-navigation document request

C.basis: Existing read cache and scoped state preserve drafts, focus/selection, reading position and existing content on ordinary failures; denial, in-flight responses, workspace change and sign-out isolation covered

D.basis: Reduced-motion styles, local feedback, Retry failure/success and modal keyboard recovery; native iOS remains separate issue1296

productionUiReplay.priorSecureAuthRequest: User-aborted before a successful designated shared-account session was verified; no success claimed

limits: A folded toast stack can overlap and intercept an intended pointer click; this limitation remains documented and is not misrepresented as a permanently blocked recovery path.
The premature LI-keyboard screenshot is excluded from the 14-image final gallery.
Existing automatic read retries are not attributed to one click.
No full shared-account production UI replay, new interactive desktop GUI run, iOS/TestFlight run or general external-service acceptance is claimed by issue1603.
Historical PENDING/OPEN fields remain as their original observation snapshots; this closeout records their later resolution.
